query:
SELECT EXISTS(
        SELECT 1 FROM discovery_jobs j JOIN discovery_sources s ON s.id=j.source_id
        WHERE j.exploration AND NOT j.withdrawn AND s.enabled AND j.expires_at>clock_timestamp()
          AND (j.attempts<$2 OR j.leased_until>clock_timestamp())
          AND (j.run_at<=clock_timestamp() OR j.last_error='budget_exhausted')
          AND (SELECT count(*) FROM discovery_requests r WHERE r.origin=j.origin)<$3
          AND (s.cooldown_until IS NULL OR s.cooldown_until<=clock_timestamp()
            OR (j.operation='list_peers' AND s.last_error IS DISTINCT FROM 'rate_limited'))
          AND (j.operation IN ('inspect_source','list_peers') OR s.valid_until>clock_timestamp())
          AND (j.operation<>'list_peers' OR NOT('source_inspection'=ANY($1)))
          AND (j.operation<>'inspect_source' OR s.endpoint NOT LIKE '%/api/v1/directory' OR NOT('directory'=ANY($1)))
          AND NOT (CASE j.operation WHEN 'inspect_source' THEN 'source_inspection'
            WHEN 'list_peers' THEN 'peer_exploration' WHEN 'list_directory' THEN 'directory' WHEN 'list_communities' THEN 'community_directory'
            ELSE 'metadata_cache' END = ANY($1))
        ) AS "pending!"
